title: Synonym, Antonym, Idiom — Level 6 — Read the story, notice, and table

items.prompt: Read the story about Raka's debate. What did the coach mean by "Break a leg!"?

stimulus.text: Raka was nervous about the debate. His coach said, "Break a leg!" Raka smiled, took a deep breath, and spoke clearly. In the end, the judges praised his confident voice.

items.reteach: Idiom "Break a leg" = semoga sukses sebelum tampil.

items.prompt: In the story about Raka's debate, which word is closest in meaning to "praised"?

stimulus.text: Raka was nervous about the debate. His coach said, "Break a leg!" Raka smiled, took a deep breath, and spoke clearly. In the end, the judges praised his confident voice.

items.reteach: Praise = memuji = compliment. Criticise justru mengkritik.

items.prompt: In the story about Raka's debate, which word is the antonym of "nervous" as it is used at the start?

stimulus.text: Raka was nervous about the debate. His coach said, "Break a leg!" Raka smiled, took a deep breath, and spoke clearly. In the end, the judges praised his confident voice.

items.reteach: Nervous = gugup. Antonimnya calm (tenang). Anxious, worried, tense bermakna mirip nervous.

items.prompt: Read the story about Sinta's savings. What is the main lesson of the story?

stimulus.text: Sinta saved a little of her pocket money every week. After a year, she had enough to buy a bicycle. Her mother smiled and said, "See? Slow and steady wins the race."

visual.text: Small, regular efforts can lead to success.

choices.say: Small, regular efforts can lead to success.

visual.text: Bicycles are too expensive for children.

choices.say: Bicycles are too expensive for children.

visual.text: Mothers should buy bicycles for their children.

choices.say: Mothers should buy bicycles for their children.

visual.text: Pocket money should be spent every week.

choices.say: Pocket money should be spent every week.

items.reteach: Main lesson: menabung sedikit demi sedikit secara teratur akhirnya berhasil.

items.prompt: Which proverb has a similar message to the story about Sinta's savings?

stimulus.text: Sinta saved a little of her pocket money every week. After a year, she had enough to buy a bicycle. Her mother smiled and said, "See? Slow and steady wins the race."

visual.text: Rome wasn't built in a day.

choices.say: Rome wasn't built in a day.

visual.text: Don't judge a book by its cover.

choices.say: Don't judge a book by its cover.

visual.text: Too many cooks spoil the broth.

choices.say: Too many cooks spoil the broth.

visual.text: Out of sight, out of mind.

choices.say: Out of sight, out of mind.

items.reteach: "Rome wasn't built in a day" = hal besar butuh waktu dan usaha bertahap.

items.prompt: In the story about Sinta's savings, "steady" in "Slow and steady wins the race" means …

stimulus.text: Sinta saved a little of her pocket money every week. After a year, she had enough to buy a bicycle. Her mother smiled and said, "See? Slow and steady wins the race."

items.prompt: Read the notice from the school canteen. What is its purpose?

stimulus.text: Dear students, from Monday the school canteen will stop using plastic straws. This step may seem minor, but every little helps to keep our rivers and oceans clean.

visual.text: to tell students about a change that helps the environment

choices.say: to tell students about a change that helps the environment

visual.text: to advertise a new drink at the canteen

choices.say: to advertise a new drink at the canteen

visual.text: to ask students to bring plastic straws

choices.say: to ask students to bring plastic straws

visual.text: to announce that the canteen will close

choices.say: to announce that the canteen will close

items.reteach: Purpose: memberi tahu perubahan (berhenti memakai sedotan plastik) demi lingkungan.

items.prompt: In the canteen notice, the word "minor" is closest in meaning to …

stimulus.text: Dear students, from Monday the school canteen will stop using plastic straws. This step may seem minor, but every little helps to keep our rivers and oceans clean.

items.prompt: In the canteen notice, "every little helps" means …

stimulus.text: Dear students, from Monday the school canteen will stop using plastic straws. This step may seem minor, but every little helps to keep our rivers and oceans clean.

visual.text: small actions together can make a difference

choices.say: small actions together can make a difference

visual.text: little children should help at the canteen

choices.say: little children should help at the canteen

items.reteach: "Every little helps" = sekecil apa pun, setiap usaha ada manfaatnya.

items.prompt: Use the table of idioms. Complete: "Missing the bus was ___: I met an old friend while waiting for the next one."
items.reteach: A blessing in disguise = hal yang tampak buruk tetapi ternyata membawa kebaikan.

items.prompt: Use the table of idioms. Complete: "The team discussed the plan until everyone was ___."
items.reteach: On the same page = sepakat, punya pemahaman yang sama.

items.prompt: Use the table of idioms. Complete: "Ayu reached the platform ___; the train was just about to leave."
items.reteach: In the nick of time = tepat pada saat terakhir.

items.prompt: Use the table of idioms. Which idiom best describes Dimas, who studies every evening before the KMSI final?

visual.text: He is in the nick of time.

choices.say: He is in the nick of time.

visual.text: He is a blessing in disguise.

choices.say: He is a blessing in disguise.

visual.text: He is on the same page.

choices.say: He is on the same page.
